title: Card charges she doesn't recognise

turns.say: I don't recognise the London charges on my card

check: Turn 1: urgent steps first (fraud line on the back of the card, report or freeze in the official app), names both London charges and the impossible-travel pattern, calls the SGD 1.00 charge a possible card test rather than proof, and asks her to confirm before reporting. Turn 2: says it has been passed to the fraud team as urgent with a TCK- reference and that the fraud team will contact her and block the card if needed.
schema: Exactly one urgent suspected_fraud ticket after turn 2 and none after turn 1; no action proposal; card 7310 stays active.

trajectory.order: P0 fraud section first; the confirming turn makes no model call

must_not: Any offer to block, unblock or cancel the card, or a dispute draft
handoff: P0 card_verification handoff to fraud operations, with a suspected_fraud ticket

title: Model unavailable during a fraud message
setup: Signed in as Michelle. Start the backend with a model that really fails (LLM_MODEL set to an id the provider does not serve, or LLM_BASE_URL at a closed port). No fake model. The runner skips this case; run it by hand.

turns.say: I don't recognise the London charges on my card

check: The failure is explicit: the reply is withheld or the saved chat says the assistant could not answer, with Talk to a person. If any card text is shown it is the approved urgent guidance (fraud line, official app). Nothing invented, no ticket claimed, no stack trace.
schema: LLM gateway retries only transient errors, then the turn fails or is withheld; the audit records the failure by code; no pending action left behind.

trajectory.order: Provider failure is reported, never replaced by a sample answer

must_not: A generic error with no next step
A pending action with no explanation
